data.one_liner: iOS and macOS implementation of Google Sign-In for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides native integration for Google Sign-In on iOS and macOS, exposing the same API as the cross-platform google_sign_in package. It handles OAuth flow, keychain sharing, and URL callbacks.
use_when: You need Google Sign-In on iOS or macOS
You are using the google_sign_in plugin and want native support without adding the package manually
avoid_when: You need a custom OAuth flow not supported by GoogleSignIn
strengths: Automatic inclusion via google_sign_in, no extra pubspec entry needed
Supports latest iOS/macOS SDKs and Swift-only implementation
weaknesses: Keychain sharing entitlements needed for macOS
Only supports Google Sign-In, no other providers
data.setup_notes: Add clientId and optional serverClientId to Info.plist or pass via init; enable keychain-access-groups entitlement on macOS; add CFBundleURLTypes for reverse client ID.

alternatives.name: google_sign_in
alternatives.why_pick_it: Cross-platform plugin that automatically pulls this package
